_comment: Calendar, from the director's Master Rehearsal & Call Schedule. Each section has a heading, an intro and a list of events in any order; the site sorts them and files them under their months. An event needs a date and a title. Optional: endDate, performance: true for a show, blocks (time and what), notes (one line each), cast (who is called: role numbers like 'Role #s 1, 4, 11-16', or ALL CAST, or None; blank for not posted yet), helpers (volunteer: a parent's name, or Needed for the sign-up link), titleUrl and titleUrlLabel.
